variants.prompt: REFORMED SCENE/SETTING: In the shadows of a lavish penthouse suite, the elegant woman reclines on a plush velvet chaise, her gown riding up to reveal a tantalizing expanse of porcelain skin. The room is bathed in a moody blue night light, with city lights reflecting off the floor-to-ceiling windows. A silver tray with a single champagne flute and an unlit cigar rest on a nearby ottoman, evoking an intimate evening of indulgence.
